summary: Remote-controlled backdoor with surveillance and persistence via api.npoint.io relay
details: gcli-control ships a `gcli host` daemon that polls the public JSON bin service api.npoint.io (DEFAULT_BIN_ID="599ac3c39189fcc26e5a") for encrypted command payloads, decrypts them with a shared password, and dispatches them to command handlers on the host. The command surface includes arbitrary shell execution (_handle_exec -> run_command), file upload/download, keystroke capture (keylog_start/keylog_read), webcam capture and recording (webcam_capture/webcam_record), microphone recording (audio_record), screenshots, clipboard access, and shell history reads. A persistence module exposes install_startup/install_scheduled/install_watchdog commands that write an HKCU\...\Run registry entry (`pythonw -m gcli host --password {password}`), a Startup folder.bat, scheduled tasks, systemd user services, or cron entries to relaunch the daemon on boot. Anyone who knows the bin ID and shared password can issue commands to any host running `gcli host`, obtaining full RCE, live peripheral surveillance, and reboot-persistent access on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
